scale_cues: White square plate assumed ~25 cm across, filling most of the frame; item sizes judged relative to the plate, with potato cubes ~2 cm and banana slices ~2.5 cm diameter.
assumptions: Brown-grey mound is chia pudding made with milk or almond milk, not a meat spread or buckwheat porridge
White scramble is egg whites only, no yolk
Round bread item is half an English muffin topped with cooked egg white rather than cream cheese or yogurt
Browned cubes are roasted potato with skin; could alternatively be roasted eggplant or sweet potato
Oil is not visible separately; ~6 g assumed absorbed from roasting and scrambling
Plate size assumed, no cutlery or hand in frame for a firm scale reference
